notes: «قال كتب نجدة إلى ابن عباس»: the writer and the one asked are links (rule 5); Ibn Abbas, whose answer is relayed, is the last link (rule 6)
«وحدثناه» starts a second isnad of the same saying; «بهذا الحديث بطوله» is a back reference to the rest of the chain, written as it stands
«وساق الحديث بمثله» repeats the saying: not a link
